title: Ta'loh Naeg Shrine

Ta'loh Naeg's Teaching}}|Map|BotW}} designated by the Trial name '''Ta'loh Naeg's Teaching''', is an [[Ancient Shrine]] in {{BotW}}. ==Entrance to the Shrine== Ta'loh Naeg Shrine is on the [[East Hill]] overlooking [[Kakariko Village]] in [[West Necluda]]. It is mentioned by both [[Olkin]] and [[Steen]]. Olkin will explain that long ago, a talented swordsman was enshrined in there, and he believes the only way to overcome the trial is to master the "secret art of defense".{{Cite|Long ago, a wise master known simply as the swordsman was enshrined—right in this village, no less. It is said that if you overcome his trial, you will master the secret art of defense. However, no one knows exactly what this "trial" entails...|Olkin|BotW}} Steen has a desire to take on the trial in the Shrine to learn the "secret art of offense",{{Cite|To tell ya the truth, I'd like to take that trial thing at the village shrine and learn the secret art of offense.|Steen|BotW}} but no one in the village knows how to enter.{{Cite|It's just... Well, no one knows the technique you need to enter the shrine. That's why I train like this every day.|Steen|BotW}} As [[Link]] enters the Ancient Shrine, he is greeted by its [[Monk]], [[Ta'loh Naeg]].{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|To you who sets foot in this shrine... I am Ta'loh Naeg. I share with you my knowledge, that it may please Hylia.}}|Ta'loh Naeg|BotW}} ==Themes and Navigation== Ta'loh Naeg Shrine features a vast, open chamber with an open pit in the middle of the chamber. In front of the elevator are two stone [[Treasure Chest]]s. The Treasure Chest on the left contains an [[Eightfold Blade]] and the Treasure Chest on the right contains a [[Shield of the Mind's Eye]]. As Link approaches the center of the chamber, a translucent, light blue [[Guardian Scout II]] wielding a [[Guardian Sword]] will rise from the pit. Ta'loh Naeg then instructs Link to [[Side Hop]] the Guardian Scout's attacks.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Use a side hop to avoid enemy attacks. This will create an opening that you can use to strike back.}}|Ta'loh Naeg|BotW}} If Link does not have a [[Weapon]], Ta'loh Naeg tells Link that he cannot practice the skill without one.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|You cannot practice this skill without a weapon. Prepare yourself and try again.}}|Ta'loh Naeg|BotW}} When Link performs a [[Perfect Dodging|Perfect Dodge]], by [[Side Hop]]ping an attack at the last moment, and counters with a [[Flurry Rush]], Ta'loh Naeg instructs Link to [[Backflip]] to avoid the Guardian Scout's attacks.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Do a backflip to avoid enemy attacks and create an opening to strike back.}}|Ta'loh Naeg|BotW}} If Link broke his last Weapon during the Flurry Rush, Ta'loh Naeg tells him to prepare and try again. Once Link performs a Perfect Dodge by [[Backflip]]ping and counters with another Flurry Rush, Ta'loh Naeg instructs Link to [[Parry]] the Guardian Scout's attack at the right time to perform a [[Perfect Guard]].{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|You can repel an attack if you parry with your shield at just the right time. Strike back in the opening you create.}}|Ta'loh Naeg|BotW}} If Link does not have a [[Shield]], he is informed that he needs a Shield to practice the Perfect Guard.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|You cannot practice this skill without a shield. Prepare yourself and try again.}}|Ta'loh Naeg|BotW}} After he successfully performs a Perfect Guard, Ta'loh Naeg instructs Link to hit the Guardian Scout with a [[Charged Attack]].{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Build up your power, and then release it to unleash a charge attack. Catch your enemies in this motion to damage them.}}|Ta'loh Naeg|BotW}} If Link broke or dropped his last Weapon before performing a Perfect Guard, Ta'loh Naeg asks Link to try practicing after getting a Weapon. Upon striking the Guardian Scout II with a Charged Attack, the Guardian Scout is defeated and Ta'loh Naeg congratulates Link for learning the skills.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|You have done well to learn these crucial skills. Now, proceed.}}|Ta'loh Naeg|BotW}} A portcullis at the back of the chamber then opens, revealing a Treasure Chest containing an [[Opal]] and the [[Monk's Pedestal]]. When Link approaches Ta'loh Naeg, the Monk gives him a [[Spirit Orb]] as a reward for completing the Trial.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Your triumph over the test of strength subverts a prophecy of ruin. From the ashes of Hyrule, a hero rises. In the name of Goddess Hylia, I bestow upon you this Spirit Orb.}}|Ta'loh Naeg|BotW}} Afterwards, Ta'loh Naeg wishes Link well before fading away.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|May the Goddess smile upon you.}}|Ta'loh Naeg|BotW}} ===Enemies=== {{Gallery List|Enemies |BotW= Guardian Scout II [Ta'loh Naeg Shrine] {{Equipment|BotW|Guardian Sword}} }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Ta'loh Naeg Shrine.png|The exterior of Ta'loh Naeg Shrine File:BotW Ta'loh Naeg Shrine Promotional Screenshot.png|Link fighting the Guardian Scout II inside Ta'loh Naeg Shrine ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ancient Shrine * East Hill * Kakariko Village }} {{Ref}} {{Dungeons|BotW}} {{Categories |Ancient Shrines, Kakariko Village, Shrines |locations= BotW }}
